paths.title: Catalogue and repair
paths.chain: An ability catalogues an unknown book in 30 warmup units; the Dawn branch can apply a 20 percent contamination link once Rhonwen is open. Soaking blocks reading. Keeper-skin removal needs an un-fatigued ability, effective-corruption support and Nectar 7, lasts 60 and yields phosphorescent scrapings. A cracked readable can be repaired at a desk.
paths.boundary: Physical book state remains distinct from learned mastery. Decontamination has fatigue plus an actual byproduct; the drying workstation branch and every catalogue deck were not reviewed.

paths.title: Reading success, rescue and failure
paths.chain: The Forge-6 book needs an ability and sufficient Forge to master. Mastery mutates the physical book and spawns a specific lesson; rereading spawns Foresight instead. Under-strength attempts draw three opportunities and allow slot-based rescue, with dynamic alternatives rechecking the current ingredients.
paths.boundary: Exhausted opportunities lead to fatigue, consolation and soul-specific malady-risk links. Only Forge success and Phost/Lantern risk were followed; other principle branches were inventoried or sampled, not all reviewed.

paths.title: Lesson to skill to higher skill
paths.chain: One Pyroglyphics lesson learns the skill only when that skill is absent. Upgrading consumes matching memories including a lesson, uses an appropriate soul slot, and triggers additive increases to skill and both principle values. Higher levels expose additional memory slots. Foresight is unique and has its own principle contribution.
paths.boundary: Memories are expendable distinct objects. The level-2 and level-9 bounds were inspected; every intermediate skill and lesson variant was not. Dawn forgetting and Numa persistent forgetting have distinct consumers.

paths.title: Wisdom choice and soul evolution
paths.chain: Pyroglyphics can commit to Ithastry for Wist or Illumination for Mettle. Commitment marks the skill and removes the unused wisdom eligibility. A compatible Illumination workstation plus two Mettle combines them into higher Mettle, using and exhausting that skill's attunement.
paths.boundary: Commitment, skill level, soul stock and one evolution opportunity are separate. Only the two Pyroglyphics choices and Mettle stages 1-to-2 and 2-to-3 were traced; full wisdom topology/placement rules remain outside this pass.

paths.title: Liquid, ink, hidden text and History
paths.chain: Pyroglyphics plus Liquid and Forge 10 yields Iotic Essence; Inks of Power plus that essence and Forge 15 yields Orpiment Exultant. Liquid fatigue turns inputs into dregs. Orpiment is an encaustum carrying several useful principles. A specific Oubliette skill can unveil the Sun's Design; its reading grants Ascent Numen. Forge 25, journal, encaustum and that numen record a History which can be presented in Numa.
paths.boundary: The higher History depends on accumulated functional outputs, a particular source discovery and a seasonal gate. Full acquisition of the involved skills, Oubliette unlocking, language acquisition and every ending are unreviewed. No whole-run completion claimed.

paths.title: Assistant preparation opens useful rooms
paths.chain: Hires spend the actual fee. Collaboration fatigues the supplied soul; a memory boost consumes that memory and sets a once-per-day category marker. A tool is separately eligible and invokes ingredient fatigue. Room preslots require actual assistance and accept one listed sufficient principle, not all listed principles. The restored Reading Room contains a constrained desk with soul, skill, memory, papers and ink/tool slots.
paths.boundary: Dawn departure removes daily assistance, while room-open effects remain separate. Full scene adjacency/rendering and all helper recruitment sources were not read. Slot requirements were checked against SphereSpec to avoid misreading OR as AND.

paths.title: Fatigue is not malady; cure is not refreshed capacity
paths.chain: Phost fatigue becomes zpho and dawn recovery returns xpho. Malady becomes mpho with reduced Lantern and a Nectar-5 cure requirement. A restorative bed action with enough Nectar invokes curing, which becomes fatigued zpho, not fresh Phost; later recovery is another transition.
paths.boundary: Treatment is a functional state chain with a concrete consumer and residual aftermath. All soul maladies, contamination and bed rules are not reviewed. No source-wide offline healing assumption.

paths.title: Calendar, weather, gathering and Numa exceptions
paths.chain: Daybreak recovers soul and separately forgets memories/departs helpers while routing daily weather. Spring versus Numa at the same garden produces Lenten Rose versus Moly. Numa temporarily pauses the ordinary season and later invokes persistent forgetting. Uncommitted skills can be discarded or reduced during Numa for universal lessons; committed skills have a refusal hint.
paths.boundary: Temporal opportunity is a changed action and changed product, not merely a date label. Night blocks the sampled gathering. Numa probability history, every season duration and closed-app elapsed-time policy were not established.

paths.title: Incident arrival, consultation and paid language
paths.chain: A non-replenishing incident deck eventually defaults to ordinary consultation. Incident setup selects qualified offstage visitors; Box arrival requires Knock or Moon interest and avoids those already marked for Box. A qualifying book consultation pays spintria, raises the visitor's interest and records the incident/book/visitor intervention. Paid Hyksos tutoring spends one tally and grants language only when absent.
paths.boundary: Visitor lifetime, leaving after success/failure, remembered action and learned language differ. No all-visitor biography/affair survey. No inference of autonomous resource economies from token routing.

paths.title: Past advice becomes competing House of Light aftermath
paths.chain: Recorded Box help for Coquille can resolve the later casket as escape, artwork and an inkling with Chandler sympathy; Dagmar's competing help can seal it and inspire fear instead. Both interventions can produce obstruction rather than duplicate victories. No intervention has a separate revealing/no-escape result. A cracked casket can still be opened by supplying a specific book or sufficiently sophisticated relevant text.
paths.boundary: Outcome, visitor inspiration, physical reward and unfinished followup remain distinct. Only this casket chain was traced among 368 nrs recipe records. Other deaths/disappearances and the full House of Light incident graph remain unread.

paths.title: Known address to paid invitation and actual arrival
paths.chain: A satisfied al-Adim gives a calling card only if no card/address already exists. Adding it consumes the card and mutates the address book. Writing requires known address, Rose 7 and ink. Posting costs one penny, is blocked in Numa, and routes a 60-unit arrival action that retrieves the existing offstage visitor token and consumes the invitation.
paths.boundary: Meeting, address, invitation, postage and physical availability are distinct. This is source token retrieval, not proven consent/appointment scheduling of all independent people. Only al-Adim's chain read.

paths.title: Supply, timing, engagement and meal aftermath
paths.chain: Cooking uses kitchen actions, soul effort and actual ingredient objects. Formal noon lunch needs at least two visitors, beverage and sustenance counts matching visitor count, four course categories and an appropriate venue; raw/unsociable inputs and Numa block it. Routed engagement uses compatible fresh soul and cycles through response/book/visitor conversation branches. Lively formal completion needs four memories and returns a curious hunch and satisfaction.
paths.boundary: Food/beverage fatigue is applied at the salon end, while conversations fatigue soul separately. Source warmup units are not assumed YAIR minutes. Only one formal lunch and selected cooking/responses, not every venue or menu.

paths.title: Directed pair histories change later relationships
paths.chain: First Douglas/Coquille exchange grants a lesson, pair-specific memory and a one-second stagger. A subsequent reciprocal exchange checks both prior history and stagger absence, then emits friendship which mutates both visitor tokens. Arthur/Coquille similarly has a prior-exchange gate before emitting mistrust. Each directional exchange has its own replay marker.
paths.boundary: Relationship change is not a generic affection increment. It is a particular interaction history with explicit participants and timing. Wider social graph, romance and all 511 response records are unreviewed.

paths.title: Authored text has actual skill and ink quality
paths.chain: Writing consumes paper at a desk and requires soul, skill and ink. A Pyroglyphics manuscript carries the skill's reading topic. Skill rank sets sophistication/mystery; matching Forge ink can add an additional skill-scaled mutation before the common setter. Physical ingredients and soul fatigue occur via linked completion. Relevant sufficiently sophisticated text is accepted by the casket-help family; salon discourse is another lesson source.
paths.boundary: Topic, author ability, physical manuscript and reader qualification differ. The casket example uses Sights and Sensations rather than Pyroglyphics, so it demonstrates the consumer schema, not that this exact Pyroglyphics manuscript solves that case. No universal self-teaching loop or all manuscript types claimed.

paths.title: Founder commitments, deadlock and institutional ending
paths.chain: Six inspired founders and the journal lock candidate preferences. Convening repeatedly collects actual appointment-bearing tokens and has a ten-step failure branch. Inauguration requires six different offices, food and drink. Opposing peace/corrivality prevents a settled peace mission; Chandler sympathy plus fear yields a separate deadlock. Mission/ally/foe plus founders select a subsequent institutional ending, with an authored Peace aftermath.
paths.boundary: Foundation is a consequential commitment distinct from ending an ordinary run; candidate loss warning is source-authored, not an observed death playthrough. No complete institution office-roster or all possible ending combinations reviewed.

paths.title: Data, state machine and durable reconstruction
paths.chain: Compendium import separates definitions/localisation/mod overlays and resolves post-import references. Recipe requirements use local versus extant contexts; group requirements qualify one complete object. SphereSpec slots require every essential criterion but one positive required criterion. Completion runs mutations, xtriggers, world xpans, deck draws and quantity effects in defined order. Ongoing prediction selects eligible always-successful alternatives; timers enter execution at zero. Saved reconstruction holds character, root population, environmental effects and version.
paths.boundary: Decompiled code export was not rebuilt. Save writer uses direct WriteAllText plus backups in the inspected method, so no atomic-write guarantee is imported into YAIR. Generic cancellation/rollback, closed-app catchup, every serializer and graphics scene lifecycle remain unreviewed.

paths.title: Finite decks and unique history
paths.chain: Dealer checks an empty draw pile, optionally reshuffles, then falls back to a declared default or returns a null token. Shuffle excludes previously manifested unique elements. Incident decks and challenge decks use different reset policies.
paths.boundary: Bounded authored decks can preserve eventual quiet ordinary life after exceptional events. No blanket claim that every random choice is without replacement or seeded/reproducible.
